description: SL Energiequellen Biogas- und Windkraftanlagen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. This dataset contains data transformed into the INSPIRE data model "energy sources" biogas plants and wind turbines from the Saarland. The transformation was carried out in accordance with the INSPIRE Energy Resources guidelines in version 4.0. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE SL Energy sources Biogas and wind turbines" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert, Saarland, HVD, geoportal, opendata, Energie. The listing shows 2025-12-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
